title: Support file-descriptor consumers inside CliRunner
description: Let C-level standard-stream consumers work while CliRunner captures Python output.
prompt: Commands invoked by `CliRunner` fail when `faulthandler`, subprocess code, or a C extension asks the wrapped standard streams for `fileno()`. Make those consumers work with the appropriate original descriptor while keeping ordinary stdout and stderr capture intact. Cover the behavior with a regression test and document the boundary.
